record.question: Which option is used to insert a picture from a file into a slide?
record.explanation: Inserting a picture from a file uses the Insert > Picture command (the exact ribbon label varies by PowerPoint version). Verified solution (unofficial); original printed source and technical explanation audited26October2026. References: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/accessibility/powerpoint/use-keyboard-shortcuts-to-create-powerpoint-presentations; https://support.microsoft.com/en-gb/powerpoint/training/apply-a-slide-layout; https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/group-or-ungroup-objects-56d8b2d3-2f31-4f50-abae-6154c1f969a9; https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/powerpoint/training/rehearse-and-time-the-delivery-of-a-presentation
